tasks.objective: Project kickoff, stakeholder alignment, requirements confirmation, UAT plan
Solution design, Power Pages architecture, Entra ID spike, wireframes for wizard, approval and dashboard pages
Environment setup, portal provisioning, theme and branding, navigation structure
Sprint management, fortnightly client demos, scope management
5-step initiative submission wizard with validation, Entra ID auto-fill, save-as-draft, security model and web roles
Sponsor approval portal page (review, approve/reject with comments), Pipeline Manager and ELT decision dashboard with scoring overview
Power Automate: sponsor approval workflow, status change notifications, email alerts on submission/changes
Excel upload Power Automate flow with mapping template, data validation and error handling for bulk initiative import
Entity lists with Group/Agency filtering, search, initiative views per role (My Initiatives, All Initiatives, Pipeline view)
Basic visual reporting: pipeline status charts, initiative counts by category/agency, scoring summary views for sector leads and admin
Prioritisation scoring (7 fields, weighted calculation), audit logging, hyperlinks to supporting documentation
UAT coordination, test script facilitation, defect triage
Bug fixes from UAT (2 rounds), performance hardening, security testing across all portal pages
UAT support, bug fixes, data validation, regression testing on reporting and approval flows
Go-live management, project closure, lessons learned
Production deployment, initial Excel data load (~140 initiatives), smoke testing, hypercare
Admin guide, Excel upload template documentation, knowledge transfer session

paymentMilestones.name: M1 - Project Kickoff
paymentMilestones.criteria: Contract signed, environments confirmed, kickoff completed

paymentMilestones.name: M2 - Design Sign-Off
paymentMilestones.criteria: Signed requirements register, wireframes approved for wizard, approval pages and dashboards

paymentMilestones.name: M3 - Core Build Complete
paymentMilestones.criteria: Portal, wizard, approval pages, reporting views, Excel upload flow deployed to UAT

paymentMilestones.name: M4 - UAT Sign-Off
paymentMilestones.criteria: Client UAT completion form signed, all P1/P2 defects resolved

paymentMilestones.name: M5 - Go-Live
paymentMilestones.criteria: Production deployed, initial data loaded via Excel upload, handover complete
